usedFor: Contacts+ holds the contacts, and Freshsales Classic changes a deal through “Update Deal” after “When a contact is updated”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a contact is updated” in Contacts+, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A changed contact often means a changed deal, so amount, stage and contacts can follow it.

watchOut: “Contact Deleted” can also start “Update Deal”, so choose the trigger that should change a deal.
